citation: U.S. Department of Labor, Occupational Safety and Health Administration, accident investigation data, 2015-2025. Public domain. https://data.dol.gov; locations geocoded with the U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder.

events.title: Employee dies of natural causes
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Paterson Grain, Llc. Bowbells, ND. At 8:00 a.m. on April 29, 2024, an employee worked alone over the weekend and was found dead. The employee died due to natural causes.

events.title: Employee is killed in motor vehicle accident
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Drop Tine Llc. Watford City, ND. At 1:15 a.m. on January 22, 2024, an employee had picked up a load and was driving a truck. The truck slipped and rolled into a ditch, resulting in a motor vehicle accident. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee dies of blood clot
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: United States Postal Service. Grand Forks, ND. At 12:15 a.m. on March 1, 2023, an employee was walking, and got hooked on webbing and fell to the floor, resulting in a right femur fracture. The employee had surgery to repair the fracture and was hospitalized for four days. About 15 days later, the employee was found dead at home from a blood clot.

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed by falling freight
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Fedex Freight. West Fargo, ND. At 1:45 a.m. on January 4, 2023, an employee was assisting with stabilizing freight that had become unstable when the freight fell on him and crushed him todeath.

events.title: Employee Is Killed By Blunt Force Trauma To Head In Fall Dow…
events.description: 1 worker death. Bismarck, ND. At 9:00 a.m. on October 6, 2022, an employee was entering an event conference center where she was attending a job recruitment event. The employee was at the event to represent her employer which is a hospital and medical center. The employee was walking through the lower level of the facility to get to the area where the job fair was taking place. The employee was walking up the stairs while carrying a cup of coffee, a bag and a purse. At the fourth step from the top, she dropped her bag and…

events.title: Employee is killed when lawn mower overturns
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Northern Lawn Services. Crystal, ND. At 11:45 a.m. on July 26, 2022, an employee was mowing ditches along a highway. The mower fell into a storm drain culvert and flipped onto the employee. The mower crushed the employee's abdomen and the employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed by asphyxia after shirt is caught in shaf…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Jones Enterprises, Inc. Fargo, ND. At 5:30 p.m. on May 23, 2022, an employee was repairing a ball return machine. The employee's shirt was caught by a spinning shaft and wrapped around the employee's neck. The employee was killed from asphyxia.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall to ground and hitting head
events.description: 1 worker death. West Fargo, ND. At 3:45 a.m. on April 7, 2022, an employee was working the front counter. Whilestanding there, he stiffened straight up and fell over backward to the floor. Earlier in the shift, the employee went out of camera view and apparently fell to the floor. In the surveillance camera footage, you could see his reflection laying on the floor in the lower right corner of the camera footage. Shortly after that he walked back into view of the camera, and he was bleeding from his head. EMT bandaged his head…

events.title: Employee is electrocuted while replacine combustion air vent…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: John Deere Electronic Solution, Inc. Fargo, ND. At 4:30 p.m. on February 24, 2022, an employee of contractor Valley Service Mechanical was replacing a combustion air ventilator for a Bryant Model 580JE08D180A2A0AAA; Serial Number 3013G10004 without locking out the equipment. See Inspection Number 1580327. The contractor employee was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee is electrocuted while replacing air ventilator
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Valley Service Mechanical, Llc. Fargo, ND. At 4:30 p.m. on February 24, 2022, an employee of Valley Service Mechanical was replacing a combustion air ventilator (Bryant Model 580JE08D180A2A0AAA; Serial Number 3013G10004) without locking out the equipment. The employee came into contact with live electrical or stored energy from the capacitor and was killed.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Eg America, Llc. Fargo, ND. An employee was working in a gas station and convenience store and last worked on November 26, 2021. The next day the employee became ill and received a positive COVID-19 test. The employee died at home at 7:00 p.m.on November 29, 2021, due to COVID-19 complications.

events.title: Two employees, one who is pregnant, are killed after being s…
events.description: 3 worker deaths. Fargo, ND. At 3:00 p.m. on November 17, 2021, Coworker #1 (Human Resources) had fired a Coworker #2 earlier in the day when he returned with a handgun. Coworker #2 shot and killed Employee #1 and Employee #2 who was carrying an unborn child of 36 weeks gestation.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Valence Natural Gas Solution. Williston, ND. An employee was working for a natural gas extraction company when he contracted COVID-19 and subsequently died from his infection at 1:00 p.m. on November 4, 2021.

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed between paver vehicle and du…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bituminous Paving, Inc. Cooperstown, ND. At 5:00 p.m. on October 15, 2021, an employee was walking along a roadway. The employee walked between a paver vehicle and a dump truck and was crushed. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed while wearing respirator after asthma att…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Farmers Elevator Company Of Forest River. Forest River, ND. At 4:30 p.m. at August 13, 2021, an employee was operating a tractor in an enclosed cab filling grain socks and wearing an N95 filtering facepiece disposable respirator. The employee suffered an asthma attack and was killed.

events.title: Employee falls to concrete floor, later dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Overhead Door Company Of Fargo. Fargo, ND. At 11:00 p.m. on January 21, 2021, an employee was troubleshooting a garage dooropener when he received an electric shock. He fell to the concrete floor and suffered head trauma. He was admitted to a local hospital and later died.

events.title: Two Employees with COVID-19 infection die
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Gwinner, ND. At approximately 7:00 p.m. on December 3, 2020, two employees contracted COVID-19. They later died from complications from the virus.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Sisters Of Mary Of The Presentation Health System. Fargo, ND. An employee was working as a nursing assistant at an assisted living facility when she was exposed to patients and coworkers infected with COVID-19. The employee contracted COVID-19, was hospitalized, and died on November 15, 2020, due to COVID-19 respiratory failure.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Edgewood Minot Senior Living, Llc. Minot, ND. An employee was working as a certified nursing assistant (CNA) in a nursing care or skilled nursing facility. She contracted COVID-19. She was hospitalized, and she died at 10:00 p.m. on November 3, 2020.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Bottineau, ND. An employee was working as an licensed practical nurse for a nursing care facility when she was exposed to patients and coworkers infected with COVID-19. The employee was home quarantining when a welfare check found her dead at 5:30 a.m. on September 29, 2020.

events.title: Employee falls through floor opening and is killed due to in…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Sf Construction Llc. Mandan, ND. At 11:00 a.m. on July 22, 2020, an employee was cutting lumber to build an interior frame in new construction. At some point, the employee fell ten feet through a floor opening between some wood studs. The employee killed by internalbleeding injuries received in the fall.

events.title: Employee is killed in grain bin engulfment
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Glinz Grain, Llc. Pingree, ND. At 5:45 p.m. on June 10, 2020, an employee was knocking down sunflowers that were built up on the sides of the grain bin. The employee was engulfed in the sunflowers and was killed as a result of asphyxiation.

events.title: Employee falls and later dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Good Samaritan Hospital Association. Rugby, ND. At 10:45 a.m. on January 30, 2020, an employee was preparing to make a bed at the hospital. Then, the employee fell to the floor and struck his head onto thefloor. The employee suffered head trauma including a laceration. The employee later died from the injuries.

events.title: Two employees are struck by crane boom extension arm as it f…
events.description: 1 worker death. Eldridge, ND. At 2:15 p.m. on December 6, 2019, an employee was swinging an extension arm for a boom crane when it fell, striking two employees. Employee #1 was killed and Employee #2 was severely injured, hospitalizing him.

events.title: Employee asphyxiates from carbon monoxide exposure and is ki…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bw-Ss Inc. Mandan, ND. At 8:00 a.m. on November 29, 2019, an employee was working in the pool equipmentrooms and was found unresponsive on the floor. The medical examiner listed the cause of death as asphyxiation due to carbon monoxide poisoning.

events.title: Employee is crushed when struck by axle as it falls from jac…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Flare Welding Llc. Watford City, ND. On November 18, 2019, an employee was lifting the axle of a CAT 930K wheel loader on a jack when it slid off and crushed him when it fell on his skull, killing him.

events.title: Employee is killed when buried in corn bin
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Columbia Grain International Llc. Arvilla, ND. At 3:00 p.m. on July 3, 2019, an employee was killed when he went inside of a corn bin to unclog the corn and was engulfed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall through ceiling
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Miller Insulation Co., Inc. Crosby, ND. At 11:30 a.m. on April 22, 2019, an employee was insulating some pipe and fell from through the false ceiling on the mezzanine. The employee fell over 9 feet before striking the floor with his head and was killed.

events.title: Employee falls from lift and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: B Square Construction. Bismarck, ND. At 3:30 p.m. on March 21, 2019, an employee was working from a garbage container that was hoisted by a lift to deliver a curtain road to the fourth floor of a building. While elevated by the lift, the garbage container the employee was standing in tilted and fell. He struck the ground and suffered chest injuries. As a result, the employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is found deceased adjacent to his work area
events.description: 3 worker deaths. Employer: System One Holding, Llc. Grand Forks, ND. At 4:00 p.m. on October 18, 2018, an employee was hand sanding wind turbine blades. The employee was found unresponsive adjacent to his work area.

events.title: Employee falls from scissor lift and is killed
events.description: 3 worker deaths. Employer: Herc Rentals, Inc. Parshall, ND. At 3:55 p.m. on August 25, 2018, an employee was using an all-terrain forklift to lift a horizontal steel beam that made contact with a scissor lift, resulting in the scissor lift being tipped over and the employee striking the ground. The employee sustained a blunt head injury from falling from a scissor lift and was killed.

events.title: Employee is pinned by skid steer bucket and killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Scranton, ND. At 9:15 a.m. on August 9, 2018, an employee was spray cleaning a grain truck trailer. A whacker bucket loader pinched the employee into trailer, resulting in fatal internal crushing injuries.

events.title: Employee is struck and killed by forklift
events.description: 1 worker death. Fargo, ND. At 4:00 p.m. on January 18, 2018, an employee was sweeping the floor and was struck by a forklift. He suffered fractures to his ribs and internal bleeding, resulting in his death.

events.title: Employee is struck by some falling materials and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Reliance Transportation, Inc. Casselton, ND. At 11:00 a.m. on September 1, 2017, an employee was opening the doors of a semi-trailer and was struck by a tote of flat boxes that fell out of the trailer, crushing the employee.

events.title: Employee is struck by motor vehicle and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: West River Striping Company. Fargo, ND. At 12:45 a.m. on July 31, 2017, an employee was painting lines on a runway. The employee was struck by a motor vehicle and was killed.

events.title: Employee is electrocuted
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Civil Contracting Services, Inc. Grand Forks, ND. At approximately 6:00 p.m. on March 29, 2017, Employee #1 was adjusting a sink basin. He grabbed or pushed a grounded copper pipe and contacted a live electrical part. Employee #1 was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee directing flat bed truck is struck and killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Custom Trucks & Auto Shine. Fargo, ND. At 8:00 a.m. on February 28, 2017, an employee was directing the driver of a flat bed truck. The employee was struck by the flat bed truck in the chest then pinned against another vehicle. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee was struck by dump truck and fractures femur
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Sundre Sand & Gravel, Inc. Williston, ND. At 10:00 a.m. on February 22, 2017, an employee was acting as a ground guide for a dump truck. The employee was struck by the dump truck and suffered a compoundfracture of the femur.

events.title: Employee is killed when pinned against concrete wall and cru…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Fraedrich Transport, Llc. Wahpeton, ND. At approximately 11:30 a.m. on June 14, 2016, an employee was connecting a dumpster to the back of the garbage truck. The dumpster was not properly secured to the back of the garbage truck. The dumpster pinned the employee up against a concrete wall. The employee sustained crushing injuries to his chest area and was killed.

events.title: Employee falls from flatbed of a tractor trailer and is kill…
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Fabricators Unlimited, Inc. Fargo, ND. At 12:00 p.m. on February 7, 2016, an employee was removing straps from a load on the flatbed of a tractor trailer. The employee fell approximately 56 inches from the flatbed of the tractor trailer and sustained multiple injures, including a fractured skull . He died several days later.

events.title: Employee is electrocuted when flat bed trailer contacts over…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Awi Transport Llc. Killdeer, ND. At 12:00 p.m. on August 20, 2015, an employee was operating the controls of a flat bed trailer so that he could raise a feed bin into position for delivery. As the employee was raising the feed bin into position, it came into contact with 14.4 kV overhead power line. The employee was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee Is Crushed By Soil Compactor and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: John T. Jones Construction Company. Dickinson, ND. At 12:30 p.m. on July 15, 2015, an employee was operating a BOMAG model BW 124 PDH-3 soil compactor on a decline. The employee was ejected from the equipment and crushed when it tipped over on top of him. The employee was killed from hisinjuries.

events.title: Employee falls from ladder and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Jamestown, ND. At 6:15 p.m. on February 20, 2015, an employee was standing on top of an 8-foot step ladder, changing the light bulb in an exterior lamp that was mounted on thetop of an eave. While the employee was standing on the ladder, the ladder becameunbalanced and tipped over, causing the employee to fall approximately 8 feet to the ground. The employee struck his head on the pavement, causing trauma to the brain , and was killed.
